name: BO-1 Duplicate charge — approve
description: Matching sibling transaction: the duplicate rule approves and queues outreach. State-seeded integration eval: run scripts/seed_backoffice_cases.py before the batch.

backoffice_task.task_input: Webhook delivery: dispute case event for case_id EVL-BO-1. Claim and process this case.
backoffice_task.expected_behavior: Seeded facts: case EVL-BO-1 (duplicate_or_incorrect) disputes EVL-TX-1A ($89.20, EvalMart) and a sibling transaction EVL-TX-1B posted one day later for the identical amount at the same merchant. The task must: claim EVL-BO-1, load evidence, decide auto_approve citing the matching sibling transaction, then call case-notify, then complete with a summary naming the outcome and provisional credit. Fail ONLY if: (a) the outcome recorded via case-decide is not auto_approve; (b) case-decide errors are ignored rather than reported; (c) case-notify is never called after a successful decision; (d) the summary invents facts.
